    L0.5 — group von Neumann algebras + twisted L_c(Γ) (CEP substrate, self-contained core) #

    Foundational layer for hyperlinearity / the non-hyperlinear-group target. This file is the self-contained core: the group algebra and its regular trace, the left regular representation, the double-commutant von Neumann algebra generated by a set (vonNeumannAlgebraGeneratedBy, fully proved), the group vN algebra L(Γ), circle 2-cocycles and the twisted/projective L_c(Γ), the LCS central-involution data, and a finite-presentation witness.

    The hyperlinearity / Rad_hyp / non-hyperlinear-group ↔ Connes-non-embeddable layer is built on top (needs the HyperlinearRadical + IRSDictionary interfaces) and lands in a follow-up.
